message:
We've all been there—your phone dies right when you need it most. That's why it's so important to have a solid plan for getting around during emergencies, even if technology lets us down. This resource from Ready.gov offers some great tips on car safety and preparedness that can keep us a step ahead when things don’t go as planned. 🚗

It’s all about knowing what to do before we hit the road, so we can navigate any bumps in the journey with ease. What’s your go-to tip for staying ready on the road?
